feeds.title: Spoon Fork Bacon
feeds.description: We are Teri and Jenny, a food stylist, and together we created this site that is full of recipes that are flavorful and easy. You don't have to be a pro to cook and bake delicious food. We hope you find something you love in our little corner of the internet.

feeds.title: The Bojon Gourmet
feeds.description: I'm Alanna, a recovering pastry chef-turned food photographer, stylist, videographer, and award-winning cookbook author. The Bojon Gourmet is a celebration of the sweet, savory, and occasionally boozy recipes that I create in my San Francisco kitchen.

feeds.title: Drizzle and Dip
feeds.description: I'm Sam Linsel. Hello and welcome to my recipe, food, and travel blog. I'm a passionate cook that decided to quit my corporate career 13 years ago and build my dream life around food creativity. Cooking and baking have been my biggest adventures, and I'm now a professional food stylist, recipe developer, and food photographer. The internet is my natural habitat, and DrizzleandDip.com is my home.

feeds.title: The Little Plantation Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Kimberly Espinel and I'm an award-winning London editorial and commercial food photographer, food photography teacher, food and prop stylist, and the author of the Amazon best-selling book Creative Food Photography: How to capture exceptional images of food. With more than 6 years of food photography experience, I'm here to help bring your food to life with my photography.

feeds.title: Adventures in Cooking
feeds.description: The page is managed by Eva who loves cooking, teaching, photography, gardening, and true crime podcasts. Follow Adventures in Cooking to read about seasonal living, recipes, flavorful cooking, food photography tips, and homesteading from an inspired lifestyle blog in the Pacific Northwest.

feeds.title: Call Me Cupcake
feeds.description: Hello everyone! I'm Linda. I live in the little town I grew up in, in the south of Sweden. In 2009 I discovered how incredibly fun baking could be. I quickly became obsessed with cupcakes and wanted to share my experiences with people then I started this blog. And I needed pictures to run a blog of course. After studying photography in high school, I had a camera that I barely used. So when I started baking, I also started taking pictures of my baked goods.

feeds.title: Vietnam Food Stylist Blog
feeds.description: Nguyen Bui is a Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam - based food stylist for TVC, Print, Editorial, and Commercial Food Styling.

feeds.title: Two Loves Studio Blog
feeds.description: I'm Rachel. Check out my Food Photography Blogs that cover all topics from food styling photography, creative food photography, and food photography editing tips. I love capturing visual stories and adore bright, clean, and uplifting imagery that emphasizes the beauty of real food.

feeds.title: Culinary Xpress
feeds.description: Hi, I am Alka Jena, a Government Official by morning and culinary custodian by evening - a role in which I discover stories, curate recipes, get intimate with ingredients, and cook & photograph flourishingly. Welcome to CulinaryXpress, the food space where the magic comes to life.

feeds.title: Diana Jeffra Blog
feeds.description: Welcome! I'm Diana Jeffra, a graphic designer turned cook, recipe developer, and food stylist. Welcome to my virtual kitchen, where all are welcome, and most of my great ideas are cooked up. I can't wait to share what I can do, and the tips and tricks of how I got here.

feeds.title: Food On Fifth
feeds.description: A food stylist's blog with simple seasonal printable step-by-step recipes, photographs & personal stories of life in the kitchen & travels, easy tips & how-tos.

feeds.title: Jason Schreiber Blog
feeds.description: Jason Schreiber, author of Fruit Cake: Recipes for the Curious Baker, is a New York City-based Food Stylist with years of experience in the food and drink photography and video for advertising editorial projects.
